The `subnets(new_prefix=128)` generator is too large. Let me fix the offer prefix generation: pick a random network address within 2001:db8::/32 aligned to the prefix length.

Let me rewrite that part: 
```
plen = rnd.choice([32, 56, 64, 112, 128])
base = 0x20010db8 << 112
offset = rnd.getrandbits(plen-32) << (128-plen)
net = ipaddress.IPv6Network((base | offset, plen))
```

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('tests/plan_bruteforce.py'); s=p.read_text()
old="""        plen = rnd.choice([32, 56, 64, 112, 128])
        net = ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8::/32').subnets(new_prefix=plen)
        pick = list(net)[rnd.randrange(min(4, 2 ** min(plen - 32, 20)))] if plen > 32 else ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8::/32')
"""
new="""        plen = rnd.choice([32, 56, 64, 112, 128])
        base = 0x20010db8 << 112
        net = ipaddress.IPv6Network((base | (rnd.getrandbits(plen - 32) << (128 - plen)), plen))
        pick = net
"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace("'prefix': str(pick) if plen > 32 else '2001:db8::/32',","'prefix': str(pick),")
p.write_text(s)
EOF
